#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'fileutils'
require 'tmpdir'

module AccessControl
  ROLES = {
    'admin' => %w[read write delete manage_users view_audit],
    'editor' => %w[read write],
    'viewer' => %w[read],
    'auditor' => %w[read view_audit]
  }.freeze

  class PermissionCache
    CACHE_DIR = File.join(Dir.tmpdir, 'rbac_cache')
    CACHE_TTL = 300 # 5 minutes

    def initialize
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(CACHE_DIR, mode: 0o700)
      # Ensure directory is owner-only even if it already existed
      File.chmod(0o700, CACHE_DIR)
    end

    def cache_key(user_id, resource_id)
      # Include both components with separator in hash to prevent collisions
      normalized = "#{user_id.to_s.strip.downcase}\x00#{resource_id.to_s.strip.downcase}"
      Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(normalized)
    end

    def get(user_id, resource_id)
      key = cache_key(user_id, resource_id)
      path = File.join(CACHE_DIR, key)
      return nil unless File.exist?(path)

      data = JSON.parse(File.read(path))
      if Time.now.to_i - data['timestamp'] > CACHE_TTL
        File.delete(path)
        return nil
      end

      # Verify cache entry matches the requested user and resource
      if data['user_id'] == user_id && data['resource_id'] == resource_id
        data['permissions']
      else
        File.delete(path)
        nil
      end
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      nil
    end

    def set(user_id, resource_id, permissions)
      key = cache_key(user_id, resource_id)
      path = File.join(CACHE_DIR, key)
      data = {
        'timestamp' => Time.now.to_i,
        'permissions' => permissions,
        'user_id' => user_id,
        'resource_id' => resource_id
      }
      # Write with owner-only permissions to protect cached RBAC data
      File.open(path, File::WRONLY | File::CREAT | File::TRUNC, 0o600) do |f|
        f.write(JSON.generate(data))
      end
      File.chmod(0o600, path)
    end

    def invalidate(user_id, resource_id)
      key = cache_key(user_id, resource_id)
      path = File.join(CACHE_DIR, key)
      File.delete(path) if File.exist?(path)
    end
  end

  class RoleResolver
    def initialize(config_path)
      @config = load_config(config_path)
      @cache = PermissionCache.new
    end

    def user_permissions(user_id, resource_id)
      cached = @cache.get(user_id, resource_id)
      return cached if cached

      perms = resolve_permissions(user_id, resource_id)
      @cache.set(user_id, resource_id, perms)
      perms
    end

    def check_access(user_id, resource_id, action)
      perms = user_permissions(user_id, resource_id)
      perms.include?(action)
    end

    private

    def resolve_permissions(user_id, resource_id)
      user = find_user(user_id)
      return [] unless user

      role = resolve_effective_role(user, resource_id)
      ROLES.fetch(role, [])
    end

    def resolve_effective_role(user, resource_id)
      # Check resource-specific role overrides first
      overrides = user.fetch('resource_overrides', {})
      if overrides.key?(resource_id)
        return overrides[resource_id]
      end

      # Check group memberships for inherited roles
      group_role = resolve_group_role(user, resource_id)
      return group_role if group_role

      # Fall back to base role
      user['role']
    end

    def resolve_group_role(user, resource_id)
      groups = user.fetch('groups', [])
      highest_role = nil

      groups.each do |group_name|
        group = find_group(group_name)
        next unless group

        group_perms = group.fetch('resource_access', {})
        if group_perms.key?(resource_id)
          candidate = group_perms[resource_id]
          highest_role = higher_role(highest_role, candidate)
        end
      end

      highest_role
    end

    def higher_role(role_a, role_b)
      precedence = { 'admin' => 4, 'editor' => 3, 'auditor' => 2, 'viewer' => 1 }
      return role_b if role_a.nil?
      return role_a if role_b.nil?

      precedence.fetch(role_a, 0) >= precedence.fetch(role_b, 0) ? role_a : role_b
    end

    def find_user(user_id)
      @config['users']&.find { |u| u['id'] == user_id }
    end

    def find_group(group_name)
      @config['groups']&.find { |g| g['name'] == group_name }
    end

    def load_config(path)
      JSON.parse(File.read(path))
    rescue Errno::ENOENT
      { 'users' => [], 'groups' => [] }
    end
  end
end

# CLI Interface
class RBACTool
  def initialize(config_path)
    @resolver = AccessControl::RoleResolver.new(config_path)
  end

  def run(args)
    command = args.shift
    case command
    when 'check'
      handle_check(args)
    when 'permissions'
      handle_permissions(args)
    when 'invalidate'
      handle_invalidate(args)
    else
      puts "Usage: rbac_tool {check|permissions|invalidate} [args...]"
      exit 1
    end
  end

  private

  def handle_check(args)
    user_id, resource_id, action = args
    unless user_id && resource_id && action
      puts "Usage: rbac_tool check <user_id> <resource_id> <action>"
      exit 1
    end

    if @resolver.check_access(user_id, resource_id, action)
      puts "ALLOW: #{user_id} can #{action} on #{resource_id}"
    else
      puts "DENY: #{user_id} cannot #{action} on #{resource_id}"
    end
  end

  def handle_permissions(args)
    user_id, resource_id = args
    unless user_id && resource_id
      puts "Usage: rbac_tool permissions <user_id> <resource_id>"
      exit 1
    end

    perms = @resolver.user_permissions(user_id, resource_id)
    puts "Permissions for #{user_id} on #{resource_id}: #{perms.join(', ')}"
  end

  def handle_invalidate(args)
    user_id, resource_id = args
    unless user_id && resource_id
      puts "Usage: rbac_tool invalidate <user_id> <resource_id>"
      exit 1
    end

    AccessControl::PermissionCache.new.invalidate(user_id, resource_id)
    puts "Cache invalidated for #{user_id}:#{resource_id}"
  end
end

if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
  config_path = ENV.fetch('RBAC_CONFIG', '/etc/rbac/config.json')
  tool = RBACTool.new(config_path)
  tool.run(ARGV.dup)
end
